item.description: US President Donald Trump presented Iran with a stark choice: reach an agreement or face the rapid “annihilation” of the Islamic Republic.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

item.title: BBC Middle East: UK to help refuel Saudi jets countering Houthi attacks
item.description: The UK says it will provide air-to-air refuelling for "defensive" operations following a request from Saudi Arabia.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
item.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
item.description: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Cultural treasures are being destroyed worldwide - so why is no-one being punished?
item.description: A cauldron of conflicts is bubbling across the world, with cultural monuments being destroyed. These people are fighting against it.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Why US plan to sell F-35 warplanes to Saudi Arabia is controversial
item.description: Saudi Arabia has lobbied the US for years to buy F35s, the world's most advanced fighter jet.

item.title: BBC Middle East: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
item.description: The BBC understands Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi are among the delegates allowed to enter the US.

item.title: BBC Middle East: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
item.description: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Verified video shows wreckage of Saudi fighter jet shot down over Yemen
item.description: BBC Verify tracks down the location of a Houthi video showing the wreckage of an F-15 they claim to have shot down.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Algae bloom that crippled Israel's desalination plants raises water security concerns
item.description: The "carpet" of microalgae stopped five of Israel's six desalination plants from working.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
item.description: Austin Tice’s abduction was approved by Syria’s former leader Bashar al-Assad, a source claims.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
item.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch of Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

item.title: BBC Middle East: How a community living under demolition orders from Israel view UK sanctions
item.description: BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the so-called E1 area, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.

item.title: BBC Middle East: Watch: Trump says Iran war will end 'immediately' after US midterm elections
item.description: The president also blamed the rising price of oil on the war, and said that prices will come down after the coming elections.

item.title: BBC Middle East: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
item.description: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.
